about: What the Node core did in scenario basics on linux-x64, frozen for the core port's C10 (tools/parity/README.md). Rewrite with node tools/parity/run.mjs --record --record-from rust; a change here is a change to the CLI's behaviour.

steps.label: step 1 ()
steps.stdout:
spawnloft - local Minecraft servers, from a terminal. mcctl remains a compatible alias. AUTOMATION spawnloft status --json Versioned status record (no configured credentials) spawnloft plugins --json Full plugin inventory spawnloft backups --json Backup history (snapshots is an alias) spawnloft diagnostics --json Recent console findings and crash report summaries spawnloft doctor --json Read-only environment checks spawnloft backup --json Create a backup; return its result and warnings spawnloft metrics --json Recorded CPU and memory measurements --follow Stream new readings; --json uses JSON Lines --seconds Limit the initial history window --csv [--output ] CSV export; refuses to overwrite an existing file Automation exit codes: 0 success, 1 operation/check failed, 2 invalid usage. Follow interruption: 130 for Ctrl+C, 143 for SIGTERM. Both names run the same CLI. spawnloft mcp MCP server on stdio, for an AI client to launch --allow-destructive Also offer restore, kill and upgrade_minecraft --show-ips Stop hiding player IP addresses in console lines LIFECYCLE spawnloft list Show every instance and its state spawnloft status Detailed state for one instance spawnloft start Start and wait until the server reports ready --detach Return as soon as the process launches --timeout Ready timeout (default 180) --no-sync Do not push registry ports into server.properties spawnloft stop [--timeout sec] Graceful shutdown via the console "stop" command spawnloft restart Stop then start spawnloft kill Force-kill the process tree CONSOLE spawnloft logs [-n 60] [-f] Read the captured console; -f follows --grep Filter lines spawnloft cmd "" Run a command over RCON and print the reply spawnloft send "" Write a raw line to the server's stdin spawnloft console Interactive attach (server survives detach) spawnloft players Who is online INSTANCES spawnloft adopt Register an existing server directory in place --jar --memory <4G> spawnloft new [options] Create a fresh instance --jar Server jar from the jars/ store --paper Download that Paper version and use it --purpur | --folia | --asp Same, for Purpur, Folia or Advanced Slime Paper --vanilla Mojang's own server jar (no plugins, no mods) --spigot | --craftbukkit Compiled here by BuildTools (needs a JDK, ~10 min) --build A specific build, for the sources that number them --fabric Download Fabric for that version (mods, not plugins) --neoforge Install NeoForge for that version (mods, not plugins) --modpack Build the whole server from a Modrinth modpack --template Start from a saved template --memory <4G> --port --accept-eula Write eula=true (you accept Mojang's EULA) --offline Let anyone join as any name, no account needed. Puts an OFFLINE/INSECURE banner in every log. spawnloft clone Copy plugins+config into a new instance --with-worlds Also copy world data (default: fresh worlds) spawnloft set key=value... memory, java, jar, port, rcon.port, rcon.password, auto-restart=on|off, webhook=|off spawnloft props [key=value...] Read or edit server.properties spawnloft plugins List plugins; flip one with: plugins disable spawnloft worlds List worlds; use , import --as , export [w], delete --yes spawnloft rm [--purge --yes] Unregister (and optionally delete files) SNAPSHOTS spawnloft backup Snapshot to backups// --scope --label --keep spawnloft snapshots List snapshots spawnloft restore [ref] --yes Restore (default ref: latest); server must be stopped spawnloft prune --keep Delete all but the newest n spawnloft verify [ref|--all] Read a snapshot back end to end and check its coverage OTHER spawnloft templates List templates spawnloft templates save Save an instance's plugins+config as a template spawnloft ui [--port n] [--no-open] [--launcher] Serve the local control panel and sign a browser in to it (--no-open only prints the one-use link); --launcher opens the game launcher instead spawnloft ui --link [--port n] [--launcher] Print a new sign-in link for the panel already running spawnloft paper versions Paper versions available to download spawnloft paper fetch Download a Paper build into the jar store spawnloft upgrade [--check] Move to the newest build for its version (Paper, Purpur, Folia or Advanced Slime Paper); --version --yes crosses Minecraft versions spawnloft pack [update --yes] A modpack server's pack: show, check, update (snapshot first; worlds and hand-added files untouched) spawnloft config Show where servers, jars and backups live spawnloft config set-root Move the data root (new servers only) spawnloft config set-instances Put servers on a different drive spawnloft data move [--yes] Move the whole data folder and leave a link where it was, so nothing stored needs changing (default: show the plan) spawnloft data status|finish|rollback Where the data is; delete the parked original; undo a move that was interrupted spawnloft config set-backup-mirror |off Copy every new snapshot to a second drive too spawnloft rename Rename an instance (and its folder) spawnloft rebuild --yes Reset worlds; keeps plugins unless --wipe-plugins spawnloft reveal Open the instance folder in Explorer spawnloft launchers [name] Write start/console/stop .bat files spawnloft jars List stored server jars spawnloft jars import [--as x] Add a server jar to the store spawnloft why Say what is wrong with a server, from its own console spawnloft diag [--client

] Zip the console, daemon log, crash reports and findings for a bug report (--lines N, --json) BOTS (plugin testing with scripted players) spawnloft bot setup Install mineflayer into the data folder, once (needs npm, ~500 MB) spawnloft bot check Say whether bots can join: offline mode, running, bound address spawnloft bot run Join as the scenario's bots, run its steps, print a report --instance Use this server instead of the scenario's --json The report as one JSON line; exit 1 when a step fails CLIENT (a game client for your own servers) spawnloft client list Profiles, with running state spawnloft client versions Minecraft versions with a column per mod loader (--snapshots, --all, -n 30) spawnloft client new --mc Make a profile (--loader, --memory, --java, --server, --harness) spawnloft client set key=val Change mc, loader, loaderVersion, memory, java, server, harness, account, assistantAccount, serverList spawnloft client remove Delete a profile (--purge also removes its game folder) spawnloft client install Download what the profile needs, with progress on stderr spawnloft client launch Install if needed and start the client (--as, --account, --server, --wait) spawnloft client status Say whether the client is running spawnloft client stop Stop a running client spawnloft client logs SpawnLoft's capture (-n 100), or --latest for the game's latest.log spawnloft client login Sign in with a Microsoft account (a code you type on Microsoft's page) spawnloft client logout Forget a signed-in (or offline) account spawnloft client accounts Signed-in and offline accounts, and the launcher's default DATABASES spawnloft db List databases spawnloft db versions [--engine e] Releases that can be run: mysql or garnet (Redis), on Windows and macOS spawnloft db add [--version v] Download MySQL by default and set up a database on a free port [--engine garnet for Redis] spawnloft db connect --host h --port n --user u --password p Register a database you already run spawnloft db address [--host h] [--port n] [--user u] [--password p] Point a database you run elsewhere at a new address spawnloft db create A database of the server's own on the port after its game port, started and attached spawnloft db attach Give a server its own database and user; prints the credentials spawnloft db detach Take the user away [--drop deletes the data too] spawnloft db creds Show a server's credentials again spawnloft db remove [--purge] Forget a stopped database [and delete its files] start, stop, restart, logs and status take a database's name like a server's. spawnloft task list Scheduled tasks, when each last ran and runs next spawnloft task add --do [--line ""] --daily | --weekly --at | --hourly | --minutes | --on-logon spawnloft task run|rm|enable|disable spawnloft task linger [on] Linux: whether tasks run while you are logged out, and turn that on spawnloft doctor Check environment, ports, EULA, disk, stale state spawnloft repair Rewrite task shims and server launchers for this install spawnloft uninstall --yes [--data] Stop servers, remove scheduled tasks; --data deletes what spawnloft made
